西遊記之四

[P2] 蟠桃宴
《西游记》之四
原著 吴承恩
改编 尚羡智
绘画 徐燕荪

河北美术出版社

内容提要
孙悟空奉命督理桃园。上任第一天，正赶上仙女摘桃，
从她们嘴里得知王母要开蟠桃大会，请了天上大小神仙，就
是没请孙悟空。他非常愤怒，觉得自己也是一尊活佛，为什
么蟠桃会上没有自己。于是他就闯进瑶池，看见山珍海味，
异果美酒，吃喝了一饱。他想溜走，谁知醉醺醺地走错了路，
误入老君住的地方。他又发现了金丹。他曾经听说吃了金丹
可以成道，忍不住又吃了一光。他知此祸惹得不小，于是就
跑回花果山。后来玉帝知道了这些情形，派天兵天将去捉拿
孙悟空。孙悟空凭着勇敢和机智，打退了天兵，取得了胜利。

[P3] 1 且说孙悟空在天宫得封“齐天大圣”，其实“有名无禄”，每日只好东游西游，行踪不定。玉帝怕悟空闲中生事，就命他兼管“蟠桃园”。悟空领了玉旨，带领安静、宁神二司前去上任。
2 刚到“蟠桃园”口，便被土地拦住问道：“大圣何往？”悟空道：“奉玉帝之命权管‘蟠桃园’，今日特来查点。”土地连忙施礼，引他们进去。

[P4] 这最后一排为一千二百棵，九千年开花，九千年结果，人若吃了，与天地同休，日月同老。
3 “蟠桃园”内香气扑鼻，桃树成行，叶绿果红，甚为好看。悟空一排排查点，土地在一旁仔细地介绍，悟空心中十分欢喜。
4 悟空查明蟠桃棵数，点清亭台楼阁，便又高高兴兴，摇摇摆摆回齐天府去了。

[P5] 我身子有些困倦，要在此休息片刻，你们在外厢伺候，不唤你们不许前来。
5 从此，悟空时常来“蟠桃园”内游玩，他见那红艳艳的大桃，真想摘下来吃它一饱，怎耐土地、力士和齐天府的仙吏紧紧跟随，有些不便。他心机一动，忽设一计，将他们骗哄出去，叫他们在园外等候。
6 悟空见他们退出桃园，心中暗喜：“好个知趣的玉帝老儿，明知悟空好吃桃果，就命我来看守桃园。好，今天就尝上一尝吧。”他脱下衣冠，爬上桃树。

[P6] 7 悟空拣那熟透的大桃摘了许多，坐在树枝上，自由自在地饱吃一顿。
8 他又伸伸懒腰，变做二寸多长的小人儿，倒卧在密密的桃叶下边，大睡起来。

[P7] 9 土地、力士和齐天府的仙吏，正在园口等得心焦，忽见七仙女手提花篮，奔蟠桃园走来。
10 七仙女见园口有人把守，便近前道：‘奉王母之命，摘取仙桃，以做蟠桃盛会。’土地道：‘仙姑且慢，今年难比往年，玉帝差来一位齐天大圣权管桃园，必须先报于他知道。’

[P8] 11 仙女听罢，便命土地引进桃园寻找大圣。他们在桃园找了多时，却不见大圣踪影。七仙女道：‘我等奉旨前来，找不见大圣，怎能空回？’土地道：‘那么，你们暂且摘桃，我替你们回话便了。’
12 七仙女欢欢喜喜进了桃林，在前排摘了三篮，在中排摘了三篮，然后她们又转到后排去摘。

[P9] 13 到了后排不觉愣住了，只见桃树上叶落果少，不见成熟的大桃。她们正在低声议论，悟空从桃树上跳下叫了一声：“哪方怪物，敢大胆偷摘仙桃！”慌得那七仙女一齐跪下。
14 众仙女说明来意，悟空心中甚为欢喜，便问道：“仙娥请起，王母设宴，请的是哪些仙家？”仙女按照实情，一一说给悟空。

[P10] 15 悟空又问有没有他，仙女回说“不曾提起。”这可气恼悟空，他说：“想我悟空也是一尊活佛，为何蟠桃宴上单单无我？也罢，待我闯进瑶池去打探一番便了！
16 悟空口念诀咒，使了个定身法，将七仙女定在桃树下，他跳出园墙，驾上祥云，直奔瑶池而去。

[P11] 17 悟空正在行走之间，忽然前面白鹤飞翔，彩云飘飘，悟空定目细看，原来是赤脚大仙，悟空想：这老道定是前去赴会，待我哄骗于他。
18 悟空迎到赤脚大仙近前说道：“老道何往？”大仙道：“蒙王母招请，去赴蟠桃盛会。”悟空道：“老道有所不知，玉帝命我约请列位先到通明殿演礼，后去赴会。”

[P12] 19 赤脚大仙心中纳闷，不知今年为何先到通明殿演礼。既然大圣告知，就信以为真，他便拨转云头，又奔通明殿而去。
20 悟空见大仙受了骗，不由暗暗发笑，他驾起祥云，急急忙忙奔瑶池前往，只见瑶池那边苍松翠柏，凤舞鸾飞，香烟缭绕，五彩缤纷，并有两个童儿在瑶池把守。

[P13] 21 悟空拔下几根毫毛，用嘴一吹，变做睡虫，童子撞见睡虫，一个个瞌睡起来，悟空转身进入瑶池，见桌上摆着龙肝凤脑，海味山珍，忽然一阵酒味飘过，悟空想：好香的酒，何不喝上一饱。
22 他一转头，见右边长廊之下有好多仙官、力士和童子们忙着造酒、烧火、洗刷缸瓮，悟空闪避一下身子想到：不妙，若被他们看见，美酒怎能喝成？

[P14] 23 悟空又将毫毛拔下几根，用嘴一吹，又变成睡虫，奔众人飞去，悟空再看时，只见他们手软头低，闭目合眼，盹睡起来。
24 悟空从桌上取来下酒之菜，走入长廊，就着缸，挨着瓮，放开肚量，痛饮起来。

[P15] 25 悟空独自喝得醺醺大醉，心中倒也痛快。凉风吹过，身子感到非常清爽，他想：大事不好，稍过片刻，众仙定来赴宴，见到此情，如何是好？干脆回府便了。他摇摇晃晃走出瑶池。
26 走了一阵，他觉得已到齐天府，抬头一看，竟错走到了兜率宫。他惊道：‘啊呀！此乃太上老君之处，如何错走到这里？’他刚转身要走，忽然又想：我一向要见此老，都未能前来，今日何不望他一望。

[P16] 27 悟空整整衣冠，走进兜率天宫，四下一看，连一个人也没有。忽然他发现炉中有火，炉上左右摆着五个葫芦。
28 悟空高兴地叫道：“妙呀，葫芦里装的定是炼好的金丹，人言吃一粒金丹能得大道，寻找此物，甚是不易，趁老君不在，何不吃个新鲜。”他顺手倒出金丹，吞吃而下，如同吃炒豆一般。

[P17] 29 他吃完金丹，醒过酒劲，不觉一愣，心里暗道：‘大事不好，喝了仙酒，吃了金丹，此祸比天还大，若惊动了玉帝，性命难保，也罢，趁此无人，不免下界为王便了。’
30 走出兜率宫，他又望见瑶池中摆设的美酒鲜果，暗想道：‘何不将这美味东西，带回去分与众家兄弟一同享用。’他拔下毫毛变成口袋，将仙桃仙果、美酒好菜装了起来。

[P18] 31 悟空趁四下无人便奔天门走去。不料，这儿有赵天君带领众将把守，这怎么过去？
32 悟空思索片刻，要用隐身法蒙蔽他们，好悟空，念一念诀咒，马上就不见了。

[P19] 33 悟空用隐身法出了天门，拨转云头，奔花果山而去。
34 悟空回花果山暂且不表。再说蟠桃园内被定住的七仙女，经过一日一夜才解脱了身子，她们急急忙忙回宫报知王母。王母一听不觉大怒。
好个悟空，如此大胆，走，随我去见玉帝。
大桃都被大圣偷吃，又行凶拷打我等，最后用定身法将我等定住……

[P20] 35 王母见了玉帝，将七仙女所说的情形又重说一遍。话还没完，造酒的仙吏和力士上殿奏道：‘不知何人，搅乱蟠桃大会，将仙酒全都偷吃一光，请玉帝做主。’
36 玉帝正要详问此事，四大天师奏道：‘太上道祖到。’玉帝便同王母出来迎接，老君见到玉帝，喘喘吁吁地说：‘我炼好‘九转金丹’，伺候玉帝做‘丹元大会’之用，不知被何人偷盗一空。’

[P21] 我奉旨赴宴，中途遇大圣，他言万岁有旨，先命臣等到通明殿演礼，到通明殿后，不见万岁，特又到此。
大圣不守执事，自昨日外游，至今未回，不知去向。
37 老君话音刚落，赤脚大仙和齐天府的仙吏也来奏报悟空所为。玉帝听后心中大怒。
38 玉帝怒道：“大胆妖猴，偷吃仙桃、金丹，假传圣旨，搅乱天宫，这还了得。”说罢便命纠察灵官前去查访悟空的下落。

[P22] 搅乱天宫者，乃齐天大圣，他逃回花果山去了。
39 灵官领了玉旨，便出殿查访。他把事情弄清后便回奏玉帝。
40 玉帝听了灵官的回奏，便差李天王率领哪吒太子、二郎神、二十八宿、九曜星官、十二元辰、四值功曹和十八万天兵，十八架天罗地网，威风凛凛，去花果山捉拿悟空。

[P23] 41 一路上黄风滚滚，紫雾腾腾，不觉来到花果山。李天王传下将令，摆好阵势，将花果山围个水泄不通，并差九曜星官先去出战。
42 九曜星赶到花果山水帘洞外，只见大小群猴唱唱闹闹，跳跃玩耍，九曜星站在洞口大喝了一声。
小妖听真，我等乃上界差来的天神，捉拿你家造反的大圣，叫他快来归降，不然，就要抄杀不留！

[P24] 43 群猴正在为悟空回山高兴地跳耍，听见九曜的声音不觉大吃一惊，一个小猴慌慌张张报知悟空。悟空听罢哈哈大笑，毫不在意。

44 悟空高举酒杯正要下饮，三五个小猴进洞报道：‘那九个凶神，恶言恶语正在骂战。’悟空笑了笑，说道：‘不要管，随他去吧！’

[P25] 这泼毛神，真真无理，本待不与他计较，偏偏欺上门来！
45 三五个小猴刚站起身来，又跑进一群小猴道：“爷爷，大、大事不好，凶神打破大门，杀了进来。”悟空闻听此言，心中大怒，把酒杯一摔，起身前去应战。
46 众猴兵正与九曜兵兵乱打，只听得悟空大喊一声“开路！”便掣开金箍棒，打了过来。

[P26] 47 九曜星官见势不好，便暂退一程。然后摆开阵势道：
“大胆妖猴，偷桃偷丹，搅乱蟠桃会，罪该万死！今奉玉帝之旨，前来收你，若不遵旨，就踏平此山，掀毁此洞！”
48 悟空听罢，怒道：“量你这些毛神，有何法力，出此狂言！休走，吃我一棒！”悟空抡起金箍棒便与九曜星官大战起来。

[P27] 49 几个回合战过以后，九曜筋疲力尽，一个个倒拖武器败阵而逃。
50 九曜进入帐中回报李天王道：‘那猴王十分勇猛，我等战他不过，败阵而回。’李天王命九曜后帐歇息，他亲自率领众将出帐大战悟空。

[P28] 51 霎时间，天昏地暗，黄风四起，悟空手执金箍棒，
翻来翻去大战天神。
52 众猴兵，一个个精神百倍，摇动大旗，击动战鼓，
助战助威。

[P29] 53 悟空的金箍棒抡来抡去，发出万道金光，二十八宿和十二元辰挡架不住，便大败而逃。
54 好悟空，大显神威，又打败了哪吒太子和二郎神。四值功曹见众将皆败，也是畏畏缩缩，不敢向前。

[P30] 55 悟空抡圆金箍棒，如飞似舞，朝李天王狠狠地打去，李天王战不过悟空，领着天兵，丢盔卸甲，四散逃亡。
56 众猴兵追将上去，抢盔的抢盔，夺旗的夺旗，那些刀、枪、斧、锤……也都被猴兵抢夺过来。

[P31] 57 悟空大笑三声，说道：‘我当天兵天将何等威武，原来却是这等无能。’
58 悟空率领猴兵，摆动大旗，高唱凯歌，摇摇摆摆，威威武武回山去了。欲知后事如何，请看第五册《紧箍咒》。
天宫空庄严，壮门面，揭穿了，无非是败絮一团。蠢巨灵，木解西闪，众天将，狼逃鼠窜，胜利大旗明闪闪，齐唱凯歌回故山，回故山。

Synopsis
Sun Wukong was ordered to supervise the peach garden. On his first day, he happened to see fairies picking peaches, and learned from them that the Queen Mother was holding a Peach Banquet, inviting all the gods and immortals in heaven, but had not invited Sun Wukong. He became very angry, thinking he was also a living Buddha, and wondered why he was not invited to the banquet. So he broke into the瑶池 (Yaochi), saw mountains of delicacies, exotic fruits, and fine wine, and ate and drank his fill. He tried to sneak away, but, drunk and dizzy, he took the wrong path and accidentally entered Laojun's residence. He then discovered the golden pills. He had heard that eating the golden pills could lead to enlightenment, so he couldn't resist and ate them all. Realizing he had caused a great disaster, he fled back to Flower-Fruit Mountain. Later, the Jade Emperor learned of these events and sent heavenly soldiers and generals to capture Sun Wukong. Sun Wukong, relying on his bravery and intelligence, repelled the heavenly troops and achieved victory.

[P3] 1 Once upon a time, Sun Wukong was granted the title of "Great Sage Equal to Heaven" in Heaven, but in reality, he had "a title without salary," so he had to wander east and west, with an unpredictable whereabouts. The Jade Emperor, fearing that Wukong might cause trouble when idle, ordered him to oversee the "Peach Garden." Wukong received the imperial decree and set off with the two officials, An Jing and Ning Shen.
2 Just as they arrived at the entrance of the "Peach Garden," they were stopped by the Land God, who asked, "Where are you going, Great Sage?" Wukong replied, "By the Jade Emperor's command, I am temporarily in charge of the 'Peach Garden,' and I have come today to inspect it." The Land God hurriedly bowed and led them in.

[P4] This last row consists of 1,200 trees, which bloom every 9,000 years and bear fruit every 9,000 years. If a person eats them, they will live as long as heaven and earth, and share the same age as the sun and moon.
3 Inside the "Peach Garden," the fragrance is overwhelming, with rows of peach trees, green leaves, and red fruits, looking very beautiful. Wukong checks each row one by one, while the Earth God introduces them carefully beside him. Wukong is very delighted.
4 After Wukong counted the peach trees and checked the pavilions and towers, he happily and proudly returned to the Heaven of Qi Tian.

[P5] I'm a bit tired; I'll rest here for a moment. You stay outside and wait. Don't come in unless I call you.
5 From then on, Wukong often came to play in the "Peach Garden." Seeing the bright red, plump peaches, he really wanted to pick and eat them. But he couldn't, as the Land God, the guards, and the immortals from the Heaven of Qi Tian were always closely following him, which was inconvenient. He had an idea and quickly devised a plan to trick them out, telling them to wait outside the garden.
6 Wukong saw them leave the peach garden and secretly rejoiced: "What a considerate Jade Emperor! Knowing I love peaches, he assigned me to guard the peach garden. Well, today I'll taste them." He took off his clothes and climbed up the peach tree.

[P6] 7 Wukong picked many ripe peaches, sat on a branch, and ate his fill freely and comfortably.
8 He then stretched, transformed into a tiny figure about two inches long, lay down beneath the dense peach leaves, and fell asleep.

[P7] 9 The land god, the guards, and the immortals from the Qiutian Palace were waiting anxiously at the garden gate, when suddenly they saw the Seven Fairies carrying flower baskets, rushing towards the Peach Garden.
10 The Seven Fairies, seeing someone guarding the gate, approached and said: 'By the order of the Queen Mother, we are here to pick immortal peaches for the Peach Banquet.' The land god replied: 'Fairies, please wait a moment. This year is different from previous years. The Jade Emperor has sent a Great Sage Equal to Heaven to oversee the peach garden. You must inform him first.'

[P8] 11 After hearing this, the fairies ordered the Land God to lead them into the peach garden to look for the Great Sage. They searched the garden for a long time but could not find the Great Sage. The Seven Fairies said, 'We have come on the Queen Mother's orders. If we cannot find the Great Sage, how can we return empty-handed?' The Land God replied, 'Then, you may pick some peaches for now. I will relay your message for you.'
12 The Seven Fairies happily entered the peach grove, picked three baskets from the front row, three baskets from the middle row, and then turned to pick from the back row.

[P9] 13 They reached the back row and suddenly stopped, seeing the peach trees with few leaves and fruits, and no ripe large peaches. While they were whispering among themselves, Wukong jumped down from the tree and shouted, “Which monster dares to steal the immortal peaches!” The seven fairies were so frightened that they all knelt down.
14 The fairies explained their purpose. Wukong was very pleased and asked, “Rise, fairies. The Queen Mother is hosting a banquet. Which immortals has she invited?” The fairies told him the truth one by one.

[P10] 15 Wukong asked again if he was mentioned. The fairies replied, 'Not mentioned.' This angered Wukong, who said, 'I, Wukong, am also a living Buddha. Why am I not invited to the Peach Banquet? Well then, I'll sneak into the瑶池 to investigate!' 
16 Wukong chanted a spell, used the Immobilization Technique to freeze the seven fairies under the peach trees, then jumped over the garden wall, mounted his cloud, and flew straight to the瑶池.

[P11] 17 Wukong was walking along when suddenly he saw white cranes flying and colorful clouds drifting. He looked closely and saw it was the Immortal with Bare Feet. Wukong thought: This old Taoist must be going to the banquet. I'll trick him.
18 Wukong approached the Immortal with Bare Feet and said, "Where are you going, old Taoist?" The Immortal replied, "I've been invited by the Queen Mother to attend the Peach Banquet." Wukong said, "Old Taoist, you don't know. The Jade Emperor has ordered me to invite all of you first to the Tongming Hall for a ceremony, then to the banquet."

[P12] 19 The Barefoot Immortal was puzzled, wondering why this year he had to go to the Tongming Hall for the ceremony first. Since the Great Sage had told him so, he believed it to be true, turned his cloud around, and hurried off to the Tongming Hall.
20 Wukong, seeing the immortal had been deceived, couldn't help but smile to himself. He mounted his auspicious cloud, hurriedly rushed toward the瑶池 (Yaochi), and saw that over there were dark pines and green cypresses, phoenixes dancing and cranes flying, fragrant incense swirling, colorful and splendid, with two young attendants guarding the Yaochi.

[P13] 21 Wukong plucked a few strands of hair, blew on them, and turned them into sleep insects. When the attendants encountered the insects, they all fell asleep. Wukong turned and entered the瑶池 (Yaochi), seeing tables laden with dragon liver and phoenix brain, seafood and mountain delicacies. Suddenly, a fragrant smell of wine drifted by. Wukong thought: How delicious the wine smells—why not drink my fill?
22 He turned his head and saw many immortals, guards, and attendants busy brewing wine, tending fires, and washing jars and vats under the long corridor to the right. Wukong dodged aside and thought: Oh no, if they see me, how can I drink the fine wine?

[P14] 23 Wukong plucked a few more hairs, blew on them, and they turned into sleep insects. He sent them flying toward the people. When Wukong looked again, he saw them with limp hands and lowered heads, eyes closed, dozing off.
24 Wukong took some side dishes from the table, walked into the corridor, leaned against jars, sat beside vats, and began to drink heartily, with no restraint.

[P15] 25 Wukong drank alone until he was thoroughly drunk, yet felt quite pleased. A cool breeze blew, making his body feel very refreshed. He thought: 'Oh no, in a moment the immortals will arrive for the banquet. What should I do if they see this? I might as well return to my palace.' He swayed and staggered out of the瑶池.
26 After walking for a while, he thought he had reached the Qiutian Palace, but upon lifting his head, he realized he had mistakenly arrived at the Douluo Palace. He exclaimed: 'Ah! This is the abode of the Lord Laojun. How did I end up here?' He turned to leave, but then thought: 'I've always wanted to see this old man, but never had the chance. Why not pay him a visit today?'

[P16] 27 Wukong adjusted his clothes and entered the Palace of Doushui. Looking around, he saw no one. Suddenly, he noticed fire in the furnace, with five gourds placed on either side.
28 Wukong happily cried out, "Wonderful! The gourds must contain the perfected elixir. It is said that eating one pill of the elixir grants the Way. Finding this is very difficult. Since Laojun is not here, why not taste it fresh?" He poured out the elixir pills and swallowed them down, just like eating roasted beans.

[P17] 29 After finishing the golden pills, he sobered up and suddenly realized, thinking to himself: 'Oh no, I drank the immortal wine and ate the golden pills. This disaster is greater than heaven. If I alarm the Jade Emperor, my life will be in danger. Well then, while no one is around, I might as well become king in the mortal world.'
30 Leaving the Purple Palace, he saw again the fine wine and fresh fruits set out in the瑶池 (Yaochi), and thought to himself: 'Why not take these delicious things back and share them with my brothers?' He plucked a hair and turned it into a sack, then packed up the immortal peaches, fruits, fine wine, and delicious dishes.

[P18] 31 Wukong hurried toward the Heavenly Gate, thinking no one was around. Unexpectedly, Zhao Tianjun was leading his troops to guard the gate—how could he get past?
32 Wukong thought for a moment and decided to use his invisibility technique to deceive them. 'Good Wukong,' he said, 'recite the spell—now you're gone.'

[P19] 33 Wukong used his invisibility technique to leave the Heavenly Gate, turned his cloud, and rushed toward Flower-Fruit Mountain.
34 Wukong's return to Flower-Fruit Mountain is not detailed here. Meanwhile, the seven fairies who had been frozen in the Peach Garden finally freed themselves after a day and night, and hurried back to report to the Queen Mother. The Queen Mother, upon hearing this, became furious.
Goodness, Wukong, so bold! Come, let's go see the Jade Emperor.
All the great peaches were stolen by the Great Sage, and he also assaulted us, finally using the Immobilization Technique to freeze us...

[P20] 35 The Queen Mother met the Jade Emperor and repeated the situation as told by the Seven Fairies. Before she finished, the wine-making immortals and attendants reported: 'We don't know who it is, but someone has disrupted the Peach Banquet and stolen all the immortal wine. Please, Your Majesty, take action.'
36 As the Jade Emperor was about to inquire further, the Four Heavenly Masters reported: 'The Supreme Patriarch has arrived.' The Jade Emperor and the Queen Mother came out to greet him. The Lord Laozi, upon seeing the Jade Emperor, panted and said: 'I had just finished refining the 'Nine-Transformed Elixir', prepared for Your Majesty's 'Elixir Banquet', but I don't know who stole it all.'

[P21] I was sent on a mission to attend the banquet. On the way, I met the Great Sage. He said the Emperor had an order, and first instructed us to perform rites at the Tongming Hall. After arriving at the Tongming Hall, we did not see the Emperor, so we came here again.
The Great Sage is neglecting his duties, having gone out yesterday and not returned yet. We don't know where he is.
37 Just as the Old Lord finished speaking, the Immortal with Bare Feet and the officials from the Heaven of the Great Sage came to report Sun Wukong's deeds. The Jade Emperor became furious upon hearing this.
38 The Jade Emperor angrily said, "You audacious demon monkey, stealing immortal peaches and golden pills, falsely claiming imperial orders, and causing chaos in Heaven—how dare you!" He then ordered the Inspector Spirit Official to go and search for Sun Wukong's whereabouts.

[P22] The one who caused chaos in Heaven is the Great Sage Equaling Heaven; he has fled back to Flower-Fruit Mountain.
39 The Spirit Official received the Jade Emperor's decree and went out to investigate. After clarifying the matter, he returned to report to the Jade Emperor.
40 Upon hearing the Spirit Official's report, the Jade Emperor ordered Li Tianwang to lead Nezha, the Second Prince, the Twenty-Eight Lunar Mansions, the Nine Stars, the Twelve Celestial Officers, the Four Duty Officials, and 180,000 heavenly soldiers, along with eighteen heavenly nets, to go to Flower-Fruit Mountain to capture Wukong.

[P23] 41 Along the way, yellow winds rolled and purple mists rose, and before they knew it, they had arrived at Flower-Fruit Mountain. Li Tianwang gave orders, arranged the troops, completely surrounded Flower-Fruit Mountain, and sent the Nine Luminaries to lead the first attack.
42 The Nine Luminaries arrived at the entrance of the Water Curtain Cave on Flower-Fruit Mountain, where they saw monkeys of all sizes singing, playing, jumping, and frolicking. The Nine Luminaries stood at the cave entrance and shouted loudly.
Listen up, little demons! We are heavenly gods sent from the upper realm to capture your rebel Great Sage. Tell him to surrender quickly, or else we will slaughter everyone without mercy!

[P24] 43 The monkeys were happily jumping and playing to celebrate Wukong's return to the mountain. Upon hearing the voices of the Nine Stars, they were startled. A young monkey hurriedly reported the news to Wukong. Wukong laughed heartily and showed no concern.

44 Wukong raised his wine cup to drink, when three or five young monkeys rushed into the cave and reported: 'Those nine fierce gods are cursing and shouting at each other.' Wukong smiled and said: 'Don't worry about it, let them be!'

[P25] This rascal monkey god, truly unreasonable! I was about to ignore him, but he boldly comes to provoke me!
45 A few little monkeys had just stood up, when another group rushed in, shouting: "Grandfather, oh, big trouble! Evil spirits have broken down the gate and stormed in!" Upon hearing this, Wukong became furious, smashed his wine cup, and rose to fight.
46 The monkey soldiers were engaged in a chaotic battle with the Nine Stars' troops, when suddenly Wukong roared, "Clear the way!" and drew his Golden Cudgel, charging forward.

[P26] 47 The Nine Stars Officers, seeing the situation was unfavorable, temporarily retreated. Then they formed their ranks and declared: 
"You audacious demon monkey, stealing peaches and elixirs, disrupting the Peach Banquet—your crime deserves death! By the decree of the Jade Emperor, we come to capture you. If you disobey, we will flatten this mountain and destroy this cave!"
48 Upon hearing this, Wukong angrily retorted: "What power do you, mere hairy gods, possess to speak such madness? Stand still, and take this stick!" Wukong raised his Golden-Hooped Rod and engaged the Nine Stars Officers in fierce battle.

[P27] 49 After a few rounds of battle, the Nine Stars were exhausted and fled the battlefield, dragging their weapons.
50 The Nine Stars entered the tent and reported to Li Tianwang: 'That Monkey King is extremely fierce; we could not defeat him and have returned in defeat.' Li Tianwang ordered the Nine Stars to rest in the rear tent, and he personally led his generals out to battle Wukong.

[P28] 51 In an instant, the sky grew dark and yellow winds rose; Wukong, holding his golden cudgel, fought fiercely with the heavenly gods, flipping and turning.
52 The monkey soldiers, full of spirit, waved their great banners and beat the war drums, aiding and boosting morale.

[P29] 53 Wukong swung his golden cudgel, emitting countless beams of golden light. The Twenty-Eight Lunar Mansions and the Twelve Celestial Stems could not withstand the attack and fled in defeat.
54 Good Wukong, displaying his divine might, defeated Prince Nezha and Erlang Shen. The Four Heavenly Officers, seeing all the generals defeated, also trembled with fear and dared not advance.

[P30] 55 Wukong swung his golden cudgel in a whirlwind, striking fiercely at Li Tianwang. Li Tianwang could not withstand Wukong, and led his heavenly soldiers, discarding armor and helmets, fleeing in all directions.
56 The monkey soldiers chased after them, some grabbing helmets, others seizing flags, and all the swords, spears, axes, hammers... were also seized by the monkey soldiers.

[P31] 57 Wukong laughed three times and said: 'I thought the heavenly soldiers and generals were so mighty, but they are actually so incompetent.'
58 Wukong led his monkey soldiers, waving the great banner, singing victory songs, swaggering proudly and returning to the mountain. To learn what happens next, please read Volume Five, 'The Tightening Spell'.
Heavenly Palace, so grand and imposing, its facade revealed, is nothing but a bundle of rotten cotton. Foolish giant spirits, clumsy and confused, the heavenly generals flee like wolves and rats. The banner of victory shines brightly, and together they sing victory songs, returning to their homeland, returning to their mountain.

full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为《西游记》连环画第四册的封面，画面描绘了蟠桃宴的场景，一位手持长棍的男子（孙悟空）在树后偷看，几位仙女在桃林中交谈，下方有“蟠桃宴”和“西游记之四”的字样。
[P2] 本页为《西游记》连环画第四册《蟠桃宴》的扉页，包含书名、原著作者、改编者、绘画者、出版社信息及内容提要，概述了孙悟空因未被邀请参加蟠桃会而大闹瑶池、偷吃仙丹，最终返回花果山并击退天兵的故事梗概。
[P3] 本页描绘了孙悟空被玉帝任命为蟠桃园管理者后，带领两名随从前往上任，并在园门口被土地神拦住询问，孙悟空说明来意后，土地神恭敬地引他们进入园中。
[P4] 孙悟空在土地神的陪同下检查蟠桃园，土地神介绍最珍贵的桃树，孙悟空查点完毕后高兴地返回齐天府。
[P5] 孙悟空因被仙吏跟随不便，设计将他们骗出蟠桃园，随后独自爬上桃树准备偷吃仙桃。
[P6] 孙悟空在蟠桃园中摘下许多熟透的仙桃，坐在树枝上饱餐一顿，随后变小躲进桃叶下睡觉。
[P7] 本页描绘了七仙女奉王母之命前往蟠桃园采摘仙桃，却在园口遇到土地神把守。土地神告知她们玉帝已派齐天大圣（孙悟空）管理桃园，需先通报他才能进入。
[P8] 七仙女奉命前往蟠桃园采摘仙桃，因寻不到孙悟空，土地神允许她们先行摘桃。她们随后在桃林中分批采摘仙桃。
[P9] 孙悟空在蟠桃园中发现桃树果实稀少，从树上跳下质问正在采摘仙桃的七仙女，七仙女惊慌跪地。随后孙悟空询问王母设宴邀请的仙家名单，七仙女如实告知。
[P10] 孙悟空得知自己未被邀请参加蟠桃宴后大怒，用定身法将七仙女定住，然后驾云直奔瑶池打探消息。
[P11] 孙悟空在前往瑶池途中遇见赤脚大仙，假装不知蟠桃盛会，谎称玉帝命他先带众仙到通明殿演礼，以此欺骗赤脚大仙。
[P12] 孙悟空骗赤脚大仙前往通明殿后，自己驾云前往瑶池，途中看到瑶池景色优美，有童子把守。
[P13] 孙悟空用毫毛变出睡虫，使瑶池童子昏睡后进入瑶池，看到满桌珍馐和酒香，心生贪念；他转头发现仙官、力士和童子们正在忙碌酿酒，担心被发现，于是躲藏起来。
[P14] 孙悟空用毫毛变出睡虫，使瑶池的仙官、力士和童子们昏睡后，便取来下酒菜，就着酒缸和酒瓮，放开肚量痛饮起来。
[P15] 孙悟空在瑶池喝得大醉后离开，误入太上老君的兜率宫，本想离开，又转念决定去拜访太上老君。
[P16] 孙悟空进入兜率天宫，发现炉火未熄，炉上放着五个葫芦。他误以为葫芦中是金丹，便将金丹倒出并全部吞食。
[P17] 孙悟空吃完金丹后醒悟自己闯下大祸，决定下界为王；随后他返回瑶池，用毫毛变出口袋，将仙桃、仙果、美酒好菜一并带走。
[P18] 孙悟空试图逃往天门，却发现赵天君率众将把守，他随即使用隐身法成功躲过守卫。
[P19] 孙悟空用隐身法逃离天庭，返回花果山；与此同时，被定身的七仙女解脱后向王母娘娘报告，王母听后大怒。
[P20] 王母向玉帝禀报孙悟空搅乱蟠桃大会、偷吃仙酒之事，随后太上老君赶到，报告自己的九转金丹被偷盗一空。
[P21] 赤脚大仙和齐天府仙吏向玉帝禀报孙悟空的行踪，玉帝听后大怒，下令纠察灵官前去查访孙悟空的下落。
[P22] 灵官查清孙悟空逃回花果山后向玉帝禀报，玉帝随即派遣李天王率领天兵天将和天罗地网前往花果山捉拿孙悟空。
[P23] 李天王率天兵天将围困花果山，并派九曜星官出战。九曜星官抵达水帘洞外，见群猴嬉戏，便大喝一声，命令小妖传话捉拿孙悟空。
[P24] 孙悟空回到花果山，群猴正为他庆祝，突然得知九曜星官前来讨伐，孙悟空毫不在意，继续饮酒作乐。
[P25] 孙悟空在花果山饮酒时，得知九曜星官率兵闯入，大怒后起身迎战，与天兵天将展开激战。
[P26] 九曜星官率兵围困花果山，向孙悟空宣读玉帝旨意，威胁踏平山洞；孙悟空怒斥对方，抡起金箍棒与其展开激战。
[P27] 九曜星官与孙悟空激战数回合后败退，向李天王禀报战况，李天王遂决定亲自出马迎战孙悟空。
[P28] 孙悟空与天兵天将激烈交战，场面混乱；众猴兵则精神抖擞，摇旗击鼓助战。
[P29] 孙悟空挥舞金箍棒，击败二十八宿和十二元辰，随后又打败哪吒太子和二郎神，天兵天将纷纷溃退，四值功曹畏惧不敢上前。
[P30] 孙悟空与李天王激战，李天王不敌败退，众猴兵趁胜追击，抢夺天兵天将的盔甲和兵器。
[P31] 孙悟空大胜天兵天将，大笑嘲讽其无能，并率领猴兵高唱凯歌、摇旗回山，画面展现其胜利归来的威风凛凛之态。
[P32] 本页为《西游记》连环画的目录页，列出了全书35个故事的标题，并包含该册《蟠桃宴》的出版信息，如原著者、改编者、绘者、出版社、印刷信息、ISBN等。
[P33] 本页为一个二维码，中央嵌入一幅小型插画，插画内容为一人在室内向数名孩童展示物品，可能与绘本内容相关。
